summary.headline: Planetary Strength and World Divisions
summary.text: Astrological rules for judging planetary strength through aspects, angularity, houses, eastern or western position, and masculine or feminine nature, with the seven planets assigned significations such as king, common people, nobles, warriors, religious people, women, merchants, and boys. Chapter 31 begins the division of the world among Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars according to their natures, with Saturn governing the superior part, Jupiter the temperate middle, and Mars the hot inferior part.
